page_title: MON 0-1 FIO | Monza v Fiorentina 22/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards wide of the right post.
90+4' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) is cautioned by the referee.
90+1' Matteo Pessina (Monza) commits a foul and Juan Luca Sacchi immediately signals a free kick.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' The free kick from long range, taken by Fiorentina, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
88' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza) is given a yellow card.
86' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Michael Kayode (Fiorentina) was quite harsh and Juan Luca Sacchi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alfred Duncan trots off the pitch and is replaced by Lorenzo Amatucci (Fiorentina).
84' It's time for a substitution. Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) comes on in place of Jonathan Ikone.
83' Raffaele Palladino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Samuele Birindelli (Monza) replacing Georgios Kyriakopoulos.
82' Pablo Mari (Monza) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
80' Referee Juan Luca Sacchi sees the trip by Lorenzo Colombo (Monza) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
79' Raffaele Palladino has decided to make a change. Samuele Vignato (Monza) replaces Dany Mota.
77' Substitution. Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) in, Arthur Melo out.
74' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina).
72' Yellow card. Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
68' Juan Luca Sacchi shows a yellow card to Yerry Mina (Fiorentina) for his blatant foul.
67' Juan Luca Sacchi couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Dany Mota (Monza) and blew his whistle.
66' The resulting corner from Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
62' Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.

62' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) was too forceful with his tackle and Juan Luca Sacchi interrupted the game to signal a free kick. It's a free kick to Fiorentina, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
61' Raffaele Palladino decides to make a substitution. Andrea Colpani will be replaced by Valentin Carboni (Monza).
57' The corner is swung in but Fiorentina can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
56' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Yerry Mina (Fiorentina) will replace Antonin Barak.
55' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) brings his opponent down. Juan Luca Sacchi has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
53' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
52' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Fiorentina will take a corner.
49' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) finds some space inside the box and latches on to a brilliant cross, but he wastes his chance as his shot goes way wide of the left post.
46' Half-time substitution. Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) will not participate anymore and M'Bala Nzola is coming on.
46' Half-time substitution. Raffaele Palladino decided to make a change. Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) is replaced by Patrick Ciurria.
46' Half-time substitution. Pedro Pereira (Monza) is replaced by Lorenzo Colombo.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Pietro Terracciano.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Nikola Milenkovic (Fiorentina) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Monza.
40' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle for a foul.

36' That was a nice football moment. Antonin Barak (Fiorentina) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the bottom right corner. Michele Di Gregorio guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
33' It's like he was asking for a caution. Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) receives a yellow card.
33' Pablo Mari (Monza) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
31' The ball rebounds outside of the penalty area and falls to the feet of Andrea Colpani (Monza), who directs his low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper is there to block the effort.
30' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
28' Michael Kayode (Fiorentina) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Michele Di Gregorio.
23' Juan Luca Sacchi has a clear sight and sees a foul from Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza).
19' Fiorentina are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
16' Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle and it's Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
14' Andrea Colpani (Monza) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
13' Dany Mota (Monza) goes on a mazy run and ends with a shot from the edge of the box, but a defender makes a decent block. The referee signals a corner kick to Monza.
12' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Andrea Colpani (Monza), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
10' Fiorentina have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
10' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders. Fiorentina earn a corner.
7' 0 - 1 GOAL! And it’s the keeper’s mistake after his poor pass is easily intercepted close in by Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina), who gleefully fires it into the net. That makes it 0:1.
4' Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Fiorentina will kick the game off.
Juan Luca Sacchi will officiate today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
